title: 노른자 지뢰밭

cuts.scene: The wife rabbit standing at the counter, mid-motion, quick, doing two things at once, holding a cracked egg with a broken yolk, frustrated expression, kitchen background.
The husband sloth standing at the counter, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed expression, looking at the wife, kitchen background.

cuts.line: 이건 뭐야, 언제 샀어, 왜 말 안 했어!
cuts.scene: The wife rabbit standing at the counter, quick, pointing an accusing finger at a small gadget, the real product, on the counter, questioning expression.
The wife rabbit standing at the counter, mid-motion, quick, doing two things at once, using the real product with another egg, surprised and impressed expression as it works.
The husband sloth standing at the counter, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed, a slight smirk, looking at the wife, kitchen background.
A guide character entering the scene, holding up a product card with the real product shown, then stamping it with a '글쎄' verdict. Standing beside the counter, clear and direct.

cuts.line: 저번에 산 그건 어디 있지, 서랍에 있나?
cuts.scene: The wife rabbit standing at the counter, quick, already turning towards a kitchen drawer, looking curious and slightly mischievous, mid-motion.
The husband sloth standing at the counter, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed, but with a hint of warning in his eyes, kitchen background, similar to cut 1.

situation: 아침 계란 요리 중 노른자 터짐
